name: Creative Newtech Limited
sector: Trading / Distribution (routing corrected from Manufacturing master)
step12_scaling_decision: A five-year projection of the credit path WAS built (Companies/creative-newtech-limited/forward_model.py), with base and stress cases and the debt path DERIVED from the funding gap rather than assumed (failure mode 18). What was NOT run is the equity-research plugin's native 3-statement workbook. Reason: this is a value-added DISTRIBUTOR, not a manufacturer. Purchases of stock-in-trade are 94.5% of revenue and FY2026 capex was Rs 3.30 crore against OPBDITA of Rs 91.11 crore, so the capex-and-depreciation machinery that a 3-statement template exists to model is immaterial here. What consumes cash is the receivable and inventory build: in FY2026 revenue rose 52.1%, net working capital rose Rs 345.32 crore, operating cash flow was NEGATIVE Rs 273.10 crore, and debt rose Rs 252.5 crore to fund it. The model is therefore built around working-capital days and derives the debt path from the resulting gap, which is the arithmetic that actually decides this rating. It covers FY2027-FY2031, carries a seven-check opening-balance tie-out, and its stress case flexes receivable days and margin while HOLDING GROWTH CONSTANT - because for a working-capital-funded distributor, cutting growth would improve the leverage path and disguise the risk. Recorded 01-Sep-2026.
